name: diagram-studio
description: Create architecture, flowchart, swimlane, topology, and sequence diagrams with PlantUML interoperability.

interface.shortDescription: Draw and edit common technical diagrams.
interface.longDescription: Diagram Studio provides structured diagram tools and an Apple-inspired visual workbench with bidirectional PlantUML support for architecture, flowchart, swimlane, topology, and sequence diagrams.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this project and create an architecture diagram.
Create a flowchart from this process description.
Create an editable sequence diagram from PlantUML source.
Update the active diagram without replacing unrelated nodes.
